description: This file defines the interface and class implementation for RDKWindowManager, including related structures, enums, and method declarations for managing window displays, input events, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: CreateDisplayRequest
classes.description: A structure representing a request to create a display with specific parameters such as client, display name, dimensions, and flags.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing the IRDKWindowManager interface, managing window displays, input events, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation::Job
classes.description: A nested class representing a dispatchable job for handling window manager events asynchronously.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation::RdkWindowManagerListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling window manager events such as user inactivity.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the provided service.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a new display with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables input events for clients.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Internal method to create a display with detailed parameters.

methods.name: addKeyIntercept
methods.description: Internal method to add a key intercept.

methods.name: addKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Internal method to add multiple key intercepts.

methods.name: removeKeyIntercept
methods.description: Internal method to remove a key intercept.

methods.name: addKeyListeners
methods.description: Internal method to add key listeners.

methods.name: removeKeyListeners
methods.description: Internal method to remove key listeners.

methods.name: injectKey
methods.description: Internal method to inject a key.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Internal method to generate a key event.

methods.name: enableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Internal method to enable inactivity reporting.

methods.name: setInactivityInterval
methods.description: Internal method to set inactivity interval.

methods.name: resetInactivityTime
methods.description: Internal method to reset inactivity timer.
